quote_en: At the interface boundary, DesignRevision records shall carry tenant_id, revision, actor_id, occurred_at and a correlation ID wherever the operation changes durable state. The request path GET /v1/design-baselines/{id} must validate input before allocating a long-running operation; if a dependency is unavailable, callers receive a documented retryable error or a persisted asynchronous job identifier, never an ambiguous success.
